Information Ceiling (E0037, exact): for any decision whose outcome event A depends on the next draw, kl(P(A)||U(A)) <= D = KL(P_true||U); the maximal fixed-K13 expected-hit lift is attained by tilting the hypergeometric null along H. A 10% K13 lift (+0.13 winners/draw) requires D >= 0.009388 nats/draw (~5.9% relative ball bias known perfectly); E0036's n=28 detectable lift 0.704 requires D >= 0.258. Downstream compression/assembly cannot exceed this ceiling. This is a mathematical result verified numerically; the INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE label refers to predictive evidence, of which this claim asserts none.
